step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify the visual layout: The whiteboard is divided into two main bounded sections: 'Data Ingestion' (top) and 'Data Retrieval' (bottom).
2. Data Ingestion components: External CSV & Excel files arrive at an initial Amazon S3 bucket (Raw). An AWS Lambda function validates this data and writes it to a second Amazon S3 bucket (Validated). A second AWS Lambda processes/ingests the validated data into an AWS OpenSearch cluster.
3. Data Retrieval components: A user actor interacts either with a web Front End (FE) or directly with a Back End (BE). The BE communicates with the AWS OpenSearch cluster and Amazon RDS for querying data. For large reports, generated reports are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket and notified to users via Amazon SES.
4. Map all services to exact allowed strings: 'S3', 'Lambda', 'OpenSearch', 'RDS', 'SES', 'UserConsumerWeb', 'ThirdParty'.

graph.name: Novantec Trade Data Ingestion and Retrieval Architecture using AWS OpenSearch
graph.notes: Data ingestion pipeline processes CSV/Excel files into OpenSearch using Lambda and S3. Data retrieval uses web/mobile frontends with Python backends querying OpenSearch and RDS, delivering large reports via S3 and SES.
